_comment: Orgs deliberately kept off the map, by slug id. Without this, re-running an import would resurrect them, since dedupe only compares against rows currently in the target file. Each entry records why.
d-d-in-a-castle: Tabletop Vacations Inc., a for-profit company selling tabletop-gaming retreats in England and Ohio. Not a volunteering opportunity.
banc-of-california: A bank. Its own site lists no volunteer program; the row came in with the San Diego batch but there is nothing for a volunteer to sign up for.
live4legacy: Live4Legacy Brand, an online apparel storefront rather than a nonprofit. Not a volunteering opportunity.
